title: How Ground Truth Shapes Retrieval Scores: Evidence-Aware Evaluation of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation System for Breast Lesions
abstract: arXiv:2610.31606v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Purpose: To describe an evidence-aware retrieval evaluation protocol for a clinical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over breast lesion management literature, addressing the dependence of retrieval scores on annotation coverage. Methods: An 18-document corpus and an 18-query development benchmark, with one Yes/No or WH-question per document, were used. Retrieval combined dense embeddings, BM25, and cross-encoder reranking. Chunk sizes of 128 to 1024 tokens, overlaps of 0 to 20%, and four retriever configurations were evaluated. Relevance was defined by evidence spans mapped to all containing chunks, treating overlapping chunks with equivalent evidence as relevant. Retrieval was evaluated using R-Precision, Recall@K, MRR, and nDCG@K. Separately, generation was assessed on a 512-token index at K=1 to 5 using DeepEval claim-level metrics, with deepseek-v4-pro as the LLM judge, and BLEU/ROUGE metrics. Results: The selected hybrid

translated_abstract: 目的：描述一种针对基于乳腺病变管理文献的临床检索增强生成（RAG）系统的证据感知检索评估协议，以解决检索得分对真值标注覆盖范围的依赖问题。方法：使用包含18篇文档的语料库和18条查询的开发基准，每篇文档对应一个“是/否”问题或特殊疑问句问题。检索结合了稠密向量嵌入、BM25和交叉编码器重排序。评估了128至1024个词元的分块大小、0%至20%的重叠率以及四种检索器配置。相关性由映射到所有包含块上的证据片段来定义，将包含等价证据的重叠块视为相关。检索效果采用R-Precision、Recall@K、MRR和nDCG@K进行评估。此外，生成质量在512词元索引上以K=1至5进行评估，采用DeepEval声明级指标（以deepseek-v4-pro作为LLM评判者）以及BLEU/ROUGE指标。结果：所选的混合【摘要在此处不完整，原文截断】
tldr: 该论文提出了一种证据感知的检索评估协议，通过将证据片段映射到所有包含块来定义相关性，从而解决检索得分依赖真值标注覆盖范围的问题，并将其应用于乳腺病变管理文献临床RAG系统的评估。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an evidence-aware retrieval evaluation protocol that defines relevance by mapping evidence spans to all containing chunks, addressing the dependence of retrieval scores on ground-truth annotation coverage when evaluating a clinical RAG system for breast lesion management.
